question: After matching actual closed-loop L1 writes in each active phase, do stage constants recover the frozen affine RNN prediction loss?
tier: Development on exposed frozen networks and panels; not independent confirmation

design.S: Previously frozen stage constants; reuse archived behavior.
design.M: [0,0,gamma3*kappa3,gamma4*kappa4]. Two positive gains per network, shared across clean/noisy observations. Native h/E/P recurrence, old E write, clipping and query preserved; no slow parameter updates.
design.phase_budget: Per episode and phase: sum over experiences of mean(abs(alpha*(Pnew-Pold))), after clipping. Initial blank excluded; phases1/2 exactly zero.
design.identity: Generic uses frozen episode_indices; Liu uses original physical subject column indices0..76.
design.calibration: Only panel1 four generic archives in each observation. Equal archive weight within observation; four separate clean/noisy x phase3/4 targets. No query readout or labels enter calibration objective. Initial blank query sequence is unchanged state initialization.
design.evaluation: If six calibration gates pass:24 M units (3seeds x4cells x2panels) with the unchanged full behavior, P_off, shuffle and eight removal protocol. Separately360 intact support-only B/S/M budget replay batches across6models x2panels x2observations x5archives x3conditions; budget total must agree with archived behavior at original tolerances.

solver.method: scipy.optimize.least_squares, trf; residual log(W_M/W_B) flattened observation then phase; central finite differences clipped at bounds. Final solver candidate only, no selection of history entries.
solver.call_bound: At most24 objective evaluations+4 per Jacobian (at most24 Jacobians), plus one final check and one saved replay: <=122 M collections, each8 generic batches. Native target collected once. No post-limit restart or broadened bounds.

decision.calibration_gate: All four point ratios in[.95,1.05] per network. First2531 A/C pair first; if either fails, stop remaining calibration and all behavior. If first pair passes, finish other four calibrations regardless of failures, lock all results; behavior requires all6 pass. Solver failure is control infeasibility under fixed recipe, not proof no matching solution exists.
decision.budget_gate: Equal two-panel average of phase3/4 M/B ratios;95% paired interval must lie wholly within[.95,1.05]. Per network, observation and domain separately. Generic point ratios weight archives equally using fixed inverse archive sample-size weights; bootstrap uses shared episode draws and those weights. Liu uniform weights. Do not infer all-cell or cross-domain matching from Ce generic matching.
decision.primary: Ce generic-global CE residual M-B; positive95 lower bound means remaining loss, interpretable beyond matched mean phase budget only when Ce generic budget gate and task competence pass.
decision.secondary: Ce generic-global CE recovery S-M; same paired draws. Report both contrasts in all4cells; raw candidate four-cell absolute performance, noise simple effects and training interactions; retain inherited competence, core and binding flags. Do not require compensation attenuation.
decision.performance: Unchanged Ce five probability NI margins-.02 and inherited eight preservation flags are descriptive qualification, not substitutes for budget matching. No claim residual loss eliminated from nonsignificance or NI alone; report recovery/residual continuously, no new CE equivalence threshold.
decision.statistics: 2000 paired subject-ID bootstrap, seed126000+seed+panel*1000000; average the two fixed panels within each network; no pooling networks. Generic CE uses native raw signed margins; omitted probability uses original paired complete-case IDs.
decision.stop: No retuning on panels2/3 or Liu. Failed evaluation budget check restricts interpretation but all prelocked24 outcomes are reported. No global constant, retraining, shuffled modulation or compact export branch.

execution.freezes: Qualified source/protocol committed; source and input/model lock committed before calibration. Calibration lock committed before any new behavior. Source fixes after outcome exposure require a successor; do not rewrite old studies.
execution.runtime: Same formal CUDA compilation profile and float32 task computation as parent; observed runtime locked after qualification. CPU scipy solver only fits two gains against frozen support budget responses.
execution.qualification: Independent small-cell native/constant per-phase L1 equations and clipping; GPU P and summed L1 agreement against original B/S rollout on panel1 generic test28 of2531/A; no new M behavior.
execution.validation: Changed-file Ruff, types, five focused tests plus architecture; study registry and docs. Saved calibration ratios and any primary CE residual/recovery/gates independently reconstruct from saved arrays; byte/hash and prior-evidence closure checks.
